negativeControls.name: Imported sword hand is moved through the actual shield face

scope: Actual skinned triangle intersections between weapon.metal/weapon.wood surfaces and shield.face/shield.wood/shield.trim surfaces. Includes the physical rim and wooden rear bracing, excludes shield grip, leather enarmes and painted emblem. AABB broad phase followed by finite edge/triangle intersections; positive crossings are recorded in world coordinates. Tests lean, regular and strong physiques at10Hz plus the reported1.36s sword frame. This is not continuous collision detection, minimum-clearance certification, coplanar contact classification, inside-volume testing, whole-body collision or a physical combat simulation.
